Tuesday is rough: Mars in your 7th House opposes Saturn in your 1st House, so a lover or client clashes. Wednesday sharpens as Mercury enters Gemini, your 3rd House, trining Pluto in the 11th House. Thursday's key turn is Saturn trine Jupiter, activating home, property, and private alliances. Friday through Sunday, Venus in Cancer sextiles Mars, softening romance and favoring a date. Tuesday is your worst day because Mars opposes Saturn across your 1st and 7th Houses. Weekly advice: put terms in writing. Follow for daily updates.
